criteria.no: The item does not state the directive: it is silent about it, names only the topic, or describes a different approach.
criteria.unclear: The item states part of the directive's content but it cannot be determined whether it plans the directive itself.
criteria.yes: The item says the qa role closes the qa bead and its task and messages the phase lead on both verdicts, without assigning anything.

addressed.instructions: `anchor.statement` requires that the qa role closes the QA bead and task and sends the phase lead a status message on both PASS and FAIL, and assigns nothing, with quality-mgr pouring the fix groups before the close. Does `item.text` state this directive's specific content as a step, constraint or decision? An item that only names the topic, or that messages the lead on only one verdict, assigns beads, or pours fix groups in the hook, does not state it. Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item is one of the ruled-out cases, including when the item is silent about the directive.
criteria.unclear: The item is ambiguous enough that it might describe one of the ruled-out cases, but it cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item states a plan, approach or decision that is one of the ruled-out cases.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan something that `anchor.statement` rules out? The anchor rules out: the qa role assigning any bead or task; messaging the lead on only one of PASS or FAIL, or not at all; the hook pouring the fix groups instead of quality-mgr pouring them before the close. These are not a conflict: silence about the qa role's close or message; validating its vars file. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item is about a different part of the system or a different activity and does not touch the qa role of atm-task-close.py: its inputs and checks, what it closes, the status message to the phase lead, and whether it assigns anything.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches the anchor's subject.
criteria.yes: The item plans or changes anything the qa role of atm-task-close.py does, including its inputs, checks, close, messages or assignments.

relevant.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one anchor (`anchor.statement`, `anchor.scope`) about the qa role of atm-task-close.py: its inputs and checks, what it closes, the status message to the phase lead, and whether it assigns anything. Does the work described in `item.text` plan, change, or depend on that subject? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys the anchor.

anchor.statement: The qa role of the close hook must close the QA bead and task and send the phase lead a status message in both the PASS and the FAIL case, and must assign nothing; quality-mgr pours the fix groups before the close as today.

item.text: On QA PASS the qa role assigns the next sprint's dev bead to the dev.
